title: WO hands Tracy the menu with its prices (never posts as dishes), the business's logo, colours, links and posts, and a dish photo only when the match is accepted
steps: S1: node --test packages/wo/website-opportunities/test/tracy-request.test.mjs — toDemoRequest from a brief with menu items and posts, against a host that announces nothing and one that announces every part

S2: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/wo-public-demos.test.mjs — GET /v1/demos/options, then POST /v1/demos with item size, price scale and photo, a logo, colours, links and a post; read wo_profile, wo_media, wo_source, then revisionForAction's brief
S3: node --test packages/wo/website-opportunities/test/domain-dish-photos.test.mjs — matchDishPhotos / confirmDishPhoto on accented, overlapping, generic, multi-dish and vision-labelled cases
S4: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/website-opportunities-handoff-pictures.test.mjs — leftoverPictures with an accepted dish photo among larger pictures
expect: S1: business.items are the brief's menu items with their printed price; no post text is an item; a photo caption is its own caption, never 'food'; a host without items.priceScale gets no price for a dish whose menu prints shortened prices

S2: options.accepts lists items.size, items.priceScale, items.photo, brand, links, posts; the profile keeps size and priceScale, the item photo as a candidate (how 'sender'), the logo as its own picture, booking as unverified; a post never becomes a menu item; the brief carries all of it, the sender's dish photo still a candidate

S3: 'Bánh bò' never matches 'Bánh bơ'; the longest name masks the shorter; a post naming two dishes names no photo; vision saying menu board, person or room drops a candidate; a sender photo is accepted only by vision
S4: the accepted dish photo is handed to the agent first

selectors.seam: toDemoRequest(place, brief, choice, media, accepts); GET/POST /v1/demos; matchDishPhotos, confirmDishPhoto, acceptedDishPhotos (domain/dish-photos.mjs); leftoverPictures(media, onSite, first)

evidence: origin/develop 97a8f2fa3e: tracy-request.js itemsOf(research.content) sent posts as business.items and public-demos.js stored them as menuItems without prices
fence: a photo is a dish's photo only when accepted (menu card or Tracy vision); the client sends only the parts the host announces
